Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.layergroup

Class LayerGroup

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.layergroup.LayerGroup
public class LayerGroup extends Object
DTO for layer group details.

Maps the response body of GET /rest/layergroups/{name} or GET /rest/workspaces/{ws}/layergroups/{name}.

Quirks verified against GeoServer 2.28.2:

  • abstractTxt — the field name in GET responses. POST/PUT uses "abstract" instead.
  • publishables.published — may be a single publishable object or an array.
  • styles.style — may be an empty string "", a single object, or a mixed array; deserialisation handles all forms.
  • enabled and advertised — not included in GET responses (unlike the Layer API).
  • bounds.crs — may be a plain EPSG string or a {"@class":"...","$":"EPSG:xxx"} object.
